research_rationale:
EO 11654 (Transfer of the Federal Fire Council to the Department of Commerce), signed 1972-03-13. The order transfers the Federal Fire Council from the General Services Administration to the Department of Commerce (Section 1), sets its membership, governing body and functions (Sections 2 to 6), directs consultation with the Federal Advisory Council on Occupational Safety and Health (Section 7, which cites a different order and does not depend on it) and supersedes Executive Orders No. 7397 and No. 10257 (Section 8). First end: Section 19 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions) names this order by number, "Executive Order No. 11654," and provides that it is revoked. EO 12379 has no effective-date clause, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1982-08-17.
